dependencies: Separate precedes/follows relations; never inferred from parent containment or document ordering

worker.workflow_observed_2026_10_19: Native workflow lets this role reach Draft, Ungroomed, Needs answer, Needs approval, In progress, In review and Paused. It denies Approved and Accepted (HTTP 422). This is existing role configuration, not a rule added here; opwork complete records evidence and leaves the item In review. Letting agents self-accept needs a workflow decision by Tom, not a CLI change.

live_acceptance.state: In review (workflow denies Accepted to the agent role); never delete

earlier_2026_10_15.delete: No irreversible DELETE request without separate exact fixture deletion authorization
earlier_2026_10_15.voice_approval: Wait for an actual user decision; no fabricated approval fixture

notes: This file is a configuration contract, not evidence of a running app.
Generic OpenProject parent links do not enforce Saga/Epic/Story grammar; opwork create validates the Epic parent.
Custom-field filters are not available on the API: source keys are matched client-side by opwork.
The old status-firewall acceptance list (protected-status denial tests) is superseded by Tom's 2026-10-19 direction; it stays under fixtures.earlier_2026_10_15 as history.

hierarchy.Saga: the whole project: goal, boundaries, roadmap, epics
hierarchy.Epic: a major deliverable with usable value, users, usable end state and acceptance evidence
hierarchy.Story: independent, bounded work one agent can finish in one session; has scope, acceptance, dependencies, owner, budget, handoff

agent_lifecycle.rule: Search first, reference the canonical item, claim it (Execution owner = session), report progress, move status explicitly, create follow-ups search-first under the right Epic related to the originating Story. Tom/Meatball groom scope; routine authorized lifecycle writes are the agent's. No status firewall, approval framework or ledger.
agent_lifecycle.completion: Agents complete when the actual acceptance criteria and existing authorization permit it and the workflow allows it. An explicit hold (Needs answer, Needs approval, a review hold) stays a hold.
agent_lifecycle.tracker_down: Return a clear error, keep bounded authorized work going, save notes with opwork checkpoint, replay with opwork flush. No daemon or enforcement layer.
agent_lifecycle.uncertain_writes: Never repeat an uncertain create; success is reported only after a read back.
